SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.employee_name, d.department_name, e.email, c.code_name AS status_name FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id AND d.deleted_flg = false LEFT JOIN common_code c ON e.status_code = c.code AND c.code_type = 'EMPLOYEE_STATUS' AND c.deleted_flg = false
e.deleted_flg = false
AND e.employee_code LIKE CONCAT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{employeeCode}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_'), '%') ESCAPE '\'
AND e.employee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{employeeName}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_'), '%') ESCAPE '\'
AND e.department_id = #{departmentId}
AND e.status_code = #{statusCode}
ORDER BY e.employee_code ASC

SELECT employee_id, employee_code, employee_name, employee_name_kana, email, phone_number, department_id, position, hire_date, status_code, remote_work_flg, remarks, deleted_flg, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_flg = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( employee_code, employee_name, employee_name_kana, email, phone_number, department_id, position, hire_date, status_code, remote_work_flg, remarks, deleted_flg ) VALUES ( #{employeeCode}, #{employeeName}, #{employeeNameKana}, #{email}, #{phoneNumber}, #{departmentId}, #{position}, #{hireDate}, #{statusCode}, #{remoteWorkFlg}, #{remarks}, false )
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET employee_name = #{employeeName}, employee_name_kana = #{employeeNameKana}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, department_id = #{departmentId}, position = #{position}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, status_code = #{statusCode}, remote_work_flg = #{remoteWorkFlg}, remarks = #{remarks}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_flg = false
UPDATE employee SET deleted_flg = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_flg = false
